title: A History of Deeds Done Beyond the Sea
author: William of Tyre

_quarry.citation: William of Tyre. A History of Deeds Done Beyond the Sea. Translated by Emily Atwater Babcock and A. C. Krey. 2 vols. New York: Columbia University Press, 1943.
_quarry.notes: Latin Historia rerum in partibus transmarinis gestarum, composed 1170–84 by the Tyre archbishop and royal chancellor of Jerusalem. The principal narrative source for the Latin East from the First Crusade (1095) to 1184. The Babcock/Krey English translation remains standard; Huygens's 1986 Latin critical edition (CCCM 63/63A) is the scholarly text.
